findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 56 mm is observed in the head of the pancreas. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. Stenosis of the common hepatic artery is observed, raising suspicion of invasion. The tumor does not involve the proper hepatic artery or the celiac artery. No other local invasion factors are identified. There are no findings suggestive of lymph node metastasis. No other metastases are observed.
